design: Building-level bootstrap of the certificate: scheme W resamples buildings with replacement within every campus, scheme B resamples campuses (each draw a separate context) and then buildings within each drawn campus; each replicate rebuilds the prediction frame and the event-level prior-record-trace table and recomputes the five gates and S with the functions of 45_certification_corrected.py, holding the fitted scores, labels and extreme-event thresholds fixed.
checks: event-level trace tables aggregate to trace_for(None) and trace_for(c) for all nine c
the identity resample reproduces the pooled map and all 141 stratum-fold certificates under both schemes
seeds: per-replicate seeds drawn from numpy.random.default_rng(RANDOM_SEED) as a (B, 2) array, column 0 for scheme W and column 1 for scheme B
scheme_B_folds: for the certificate governing campus c, its eight certifying campuses are resampled with replacement (eight draws) and read through f^(-{c,d})
not_certified_if_ungated: a stratum that fails the eligibility filter (20 positives, 200 rows) in a replicate counts as not certified
